concept.description:
BunnySlop AI Style.

big boobs 1 girls slop style IL/Anima LoRA. from Slopia with love.|
Anima v5.56 : more vibrant color this maybe final ver.
IL v5.56 : kinda unstable in some checkpoint. lower it weight when it happen

since most of my dataset are black haired girl, it may bias toward that.

This is my first attempt at create LoRa. this shit gonna be suck. you has been warned.

I create this intended for personal use because I'm tired of have to stack shit ton of style LoRas to get style I want and I'm suck at using artist tag. skill issues.

Preview image setting
Sampler: Eular a

Schedule type: Simple

Step: 32

CFG Scale: 4

Hires-fix upcaler: 4x_IllustrationJaNai_V1_DAT2_190k, x1.5, 20 step

gen with Forge neo. so no workflow for ya.
